name: L4 Collision and the world file
body: Port `physics` (triangles, capsule casts, `CollisionWorld`, kinematic bodies and `CharacterController`) and `world-format`, which `course_traversal` needs to load the real world file. Add a trace mode to both engines that prints the player's position, velocity and grounded state each fixed step, and choose the float tolerance from the first run.

acceptance_criteria.text: `physics`'s 27 Rust tests pass as `nox test` programs
`world-format`'s 6 Rust tests pass as `nox test` programs
`course_traversal` passes over the real world file at several display rates
The float tolerance is stated, with how it was chosen

definition_of_done.text: PR into `nox-proto`, reviewed, with the milestone's checks passing
